SSC REGISTER (from the model; per-module items grouped)
Reactor building (Seismic Category I, below-grade pool)
Reactor building steam gallery area (behind the module bays' shield walls)
Common reactor pool / ultimate heat sink
Single control room for up to 12 modules
Electrical power (non-Class 1E AC and DC; no safety-related function relies on it)
module n bay (in the pool, shield wall to the steam gallery)
power module n: RPV with core, pressurizer, two helical-coil SGs
module n DHRS train 1 isolation valves
module n DHRS train 1 condenser (in the pool)
module n DHRS train 2 isolation valves
module n DHRS train 2 condenser (in the pool)
module n ECCS reactor vent valve 1 (main, IAB, trip and reset valves)
module n ECCS reactor vent valve 2 (main, IAB, trip and reset valves)
module n ECCS reactor vent valve 3 (main, IAB, trip and reset valves)
module n ECCS reactor recirculation valve 1 (main, IAB, trip and reset valves)
module n ECCS reactor recirculation valve 2 (main, IAB, trip and reset valves)
F-bay-size [frontiers-2023, 1.1 Reactor configuration]: "Each NPM is operated in its own bay, immersed in a pool of water which is approximately 20 ft square by 53 ft deep (see Figure 3 )."
F-bay-size [frontiers-2023, 1.1 Reactor configuration]: "Each NPM is operated in its own bay, immersed in a pool of water which is approximately 20 ft square by 53 ft deep (see Figure 3 )."
F-cnv-size [frontiers-2023, 1.1 Reactor configuration]: "The reactor vessel is enclosed in a stainless steel containment vessel (CNV) that is nominally 76 ft tall and 19 ft in diameter."
F-cnv-size [frontiers-2023, 1.1 Reactor configuration]: "The reactor vessel is enclosed in a stainless steel containment vessel (CNV) that is nominally 76 ft tall and 19 ft in diameter."
CNV top above the pool surface
computed: CNV height - bay water depth, with the CNV seated on the bay floor (D, schematic); consistent with the rule's "partially submerged" (F-pool), not a sourced elevation
Radial clearance, CNV to bay side
computed: (bay side - CNV diameter) / 2 from the two S2 nominal values; flanges, supports and guides not modelled
not in the sources read; stated only: F-pool-grade [fr-2023-00729, I. Background]: "The pool portion of the reactor building is located below grade."

C-rvv-count: number of ECCS reactor vent valves per module: 3 (F-eccs, fr-2023-00729 (US600 rule, primary)) vs 2 (F-eccs-2rvv, frontiers-2023 (secondary; describes the later design family)); pending_human_review
SCREENING DRAWING of a public-source skeleton: not a plant drawing; not for construction, licensing or safety use.
S2 = secondary, design-family value (Welter et al. 2023 also covers US460 / VOYGR): NOT a confirmed US600 dimension.
C = computed from drawn values; D = schematic placement; UNK = not drawn. Units ft (m in brackets).
Revision = hash of the facility model; any model change gives a new revision and supersedes this sheet.
Unknowns stay unknown until a human reads the FSAR sections on sheet 3.
